name: Chloe Anderson
original_name: クロエ・アンデルソン
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Operator
Birthplace: France (Marseille)

An operator on the Elusion that understands and reports on the status of the ship during battle.
An unlucky girl whose family business was ruined, and who was attacked by the enemy during training. But she doesn't let that bother her and she goes about her job cheerfully while admiring the protagonist as an older sister type.
